requirements.title: Inquiry array arguments need not have defined shape unless otherwise specified
requirements.definition: Unless otherwise specified, intrinsic inquiry functions accept array arguments whose shape need not be defined.

pending.inquiry-array-shape-need-not-be-defined: Use a later inquiry not overriding this permission; establish the undefined-shape premise and assert only the inquiry-defined property.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish a non-default or load-bearing state first and observe only portable properties fixed by this unit or the cited 16.9 specification: exact integer, logical, character, bit-sequence, STAT, kind/model-parameter, class, or procedure-use behavior. Diagnostic plans are source-control plans; numbered constraints with required diagnostic obligations state rejection as their separate portable oracle. Processor-dependent representations, command/environment/time state, failed/stopped-image availability, approximation quality, ordering latitude, progress timing, and explanatory message text are not asserted.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Fixture authors must re-derive each pending plan from the pinned source before binding it.

Unregistered dependencies explicitly retained: individual 16.9 intrinsic specifications, ISO_FORTRAN_ENV named constants, and intrinsic-module semantics where a future fixture reaches them.

requirements.title: Transformational and elemental array argument shapes shall be defined
requirements.definition: The shape of array arguments to transformational and elemental intrinsic functions shall be defined.

pending.transformational-array-shape-defined: Control uses defined-shape arrays; mutation changes only shape definedness and does not claim a diagnostic from this unnumbered rule. A separate numbered/context rule must own any diagnostic.
pending.elemental-array-shape-defined: Control uses defined-shape arrays; mutation changes only shape definedness and does not claim a diagnostic from this unnumbered rule. A separate numbered/context rule must own any diagnostic.

review_rationale: Source registration for Clause 16 general text, 16 through 16.8: intrinsic procedure classes and general rules, the bit and numeric models, atomic and collective subroutines, and the standard generic and specific name tables (batch178). This opens Clause 16. Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; round 1 found conditional pending plans for the atomic and collective STAT semantics, now resolved into explicit decisions: image-dependent facets are out of scope for single-image fixtures by user decision, and the 'any other error' STAT values have no portable oracle because such an error cannot be induced portably. C1601 and C1602 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
